tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs/

sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba'i ye shes nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rnam par rol pa can/ /dpal ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs nyams su len bde ba zhig bshad par bya ste/ spyir bde mchog gi sgrub thabs la lha re gnyis ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma/ dpa' gcig / 'khor lo gsum so so'i dbang du byas pa'i sgrub thabs las mang du bshad cing khyad par du lhan skyes la phyag bcu gnyis ma dang phyag gnyis ma sogs du ma rgyud dang rgya gzhung las 'byung ngo*/ /'dir phyag bcu gnyis ma'i dbang du byas te 'chad pa la/ bde mchog gi dbang bskur thob pa zhig gis/ gnas yid dang mthun par 'di'i dris sku dang mchod gtor sogs ci 'byor sta gon byas te/ skyabs sems ni/ mchog gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ he ru ka dpal yab yum la/ /skyabs mchi sems can don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de nas rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas rgyas pa 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ bsdus pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdor sems he ru ka dkar bo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snye ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs ka'i zla gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ de la 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrig sgrib sbyangs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsams la/ he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig gam bdun bzla/ de nas bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /zhes sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /dag pa gsum ni/

shri he ru ka he ni kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i sems te rgyu'i bdag nyid du brtag par byas pa'i stong ba'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ ka ni de kho na nyid yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor mi gnas pa dang*/ shri ni yul stong ba nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gyi don no/ /stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gu dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ de nas/ oṃ a ā nas/ k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃphaṭa/ lan gsum/ rang gi lte bar dbyangs gsal gyi 'phreng ba lan gsum gyis bskor ba las he ru ka'i tshogs 'phros pa sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon bgegs bskrad/ slar byon sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /thob zin pa'i bde ba brtan par gyur cig /yid de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po/ /de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil kyi bar gang bas thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs/ yus shel gong ltar dag par gyur te/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/

he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa chen rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ 'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ / rang gi snying ka'i hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ tsakra saṃ bar ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gam/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā dar+she hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wi ni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghan+dhe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā sa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra swar+she hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ de nas rkang brgyad kyis bstod pas mchod dam min yang rung*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ /zhes sogs kyi rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying khar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsam mo/ /'di'i rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig las mngon byang lngas bskyed pa mi snang yang*/ bskyed pa ni yegs pas de la 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas shung+ngho3haṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od kyi rnam par gyur pa rang la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas rim kyis hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu nas/ nā da'i bar rim gyis thim zhing*/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya ha nas ko3haṃ/ bar do longs sku'i lam khyer ni/ stong ba'i rang las rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du bsgreng zhing phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu/ oṃ grih+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar bo/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan pid+yā rā dza huṃ huṃ phaṭa/

lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser bo rnams su 'khod par gyur/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i kha dog can rnams kyi 'od zer tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab pa'i 'od zer chen po'i gzugs rnams su gyur/ sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las shar nag /byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i ra ba gru bzhi pa tshad de lta bu/ ra ba grub pa dang mnyam du 'og tu hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje sa gzhi/ staing du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re/ de'i phyi rol du mda'i dra ba/ rdo rje'i ra gur rnams bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i me 'jigs dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ oṃ me de nī badz+ra bha wa badz+ra bhan+d+ya hūṃ oṃ badz+ra brā kar hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañcha ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ /oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs bzhi brjod de/ 'gro ba rnams rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur par bsam mo/ /rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig dang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dar 'byung bzhi dang rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang dur khrod rnams bskyed tshul shin tu bsdus kyang*/ 'dir 'bring bo'i dbang du byas te sprul sku'i lam khyer ne/ srung 'khor gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar bo gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar bo zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser bo gru bzhi ba rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab gru bzhi ba lcogs brgyad kyis mdzes pa/

de'i steng du baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a āḥ nas aṃ aḥste dbyangs yig dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang a āḥnas aṃ aḥste dbyangs yig dkar po phrag gcig g.yon bskor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha ga gha nga nas sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang ka kha ga nga gha nas sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig gis g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la dbyangs gsal gnyis gzugs brnyan bzhin du shar ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang sems nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar dmar mthong nas de'i dbus su zhugs pas/ slar yang nā da nas ū'i bar rim pa bzhin du hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin du rdzogs par gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ yig gi nā da las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne las he ru ka'i tshogs dpag tu med spros pas 'gro ba rnams he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ thog ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig spyan drangs/ snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu nas hūṃ yig la thim pas hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi nī kā ya wā kā tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+nghaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shung+ngho3haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/

/rten gyi gzhal yas khang de yang gru bzhi ba/ sgo bzhi ba phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa/ nang gi shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser dbus sngo ba/ pha gu'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi/ phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las dpyangs pa'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa mdzes par byas shing*/ steng gi zur bzhir gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i 'tshams dang 'og gi phyi nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs gser la sogs pa'i snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang bo las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang*/ spṛn gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i ra ba me ri dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad na shing brgyad/ de la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang zhing skyong brgyad/ chu brgyad dang*/ der gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ me brgyad/ gzhan yang keng rus gang gsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/

khwa dang 'ug pa dang bya rgod la sogs pa dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang grub pa thob pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi ba'i rtsa zhal nag /g.yon zhal ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal ra re yang spyan gsum pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu re re la thod pa bskam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs bas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍa ma ru dang ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan cing*/ g.yon bskums bas dus mtshan ma dmar bo lag pa bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing*/ lhag ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i nu ma mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ka'ang gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang bo che'i lpags pa rlon pa bsdigs mdzub dang bcas pas brkyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi ba na dgra sta/ lnga ba na gri gug /drug pa nam dung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi ba na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga ba na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi ba bsnams shing sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa sogs nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i gsham thab can/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcus phreng ba byas pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byug pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/

/zhal gcig /phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gcer mo skra krol ba/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og bag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gi gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yas pas gdug pa can kun la gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla yi steng nas legs par 'khril ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo bskam po lnga'i thod dang*/ bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ dkar bo las rdo rje dkar bo rdo rje lnga ba byā dmar bo las byung ba'i nor bu dmar bo byā ser bos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas āḥdamar bo las pad+ma dmar bo 'dab ma gsum pa d+yā dkar bo byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar bo d+yā ser bos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte bar zla gdan la oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ thugs kar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bung+ngha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar nyi gdan la oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la shrī badz+ra sogs dang*/ thugs kar nyi gdan la hrīḥha sogs dang*/ mgrin par zla gdan la oṃ badz+ra bai ro sogs dang*/ dpral bar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bung+ngha sogs sngar bzhin no/ /sngags rnams kha dog dmar bo/ g.yon skor du phan tshun zhal sbyor bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems spyi bo nas zhu ba mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ snying khar slebs pa na mchog dga'/ lte bar slebs pa na khyad dga'/ nor bu'i rtser slebs pa na lhan skyes kyi dga' ba skyes/ bde bas stong ba nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyar nas/

yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka ste yab yum gnyis bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes ngo bo rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ go cha ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser bo/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar bo/ phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la he ru ka'i ngo bo ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar bo/ snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon po/ mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ maṃ dkar bo/ mgo bor nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hreṃ ser bo/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ dpral bar nyi ma la tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud khas mtshan pa/ spyir bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ pheṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bde mchog gi ye shes pa'i 'khor lo dang dbang gi lha rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bi ra yo gi ni ka ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shung+ngho3haṃ/ de nas dbang lha la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/

gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum dang lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas shrī ye hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las/ yab la rdor sems dang yum la rnam snang gi dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum mam 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ chu gsum dang bcas pa'i mchod pa byin brlab bya ba ni/ khaṇ+ḍa ro has bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ /zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ shrīḥhe ru ka sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang*/ sngar ltar rig ma drug gam/ bcu drug gis kyang mchod du rung*/ nang mchod ni/ mchod do/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi= rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i= grub chen lū dril nag gsum gyi= chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po'i= mkhas grub ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi= rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho'i= bde mchog brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi= gzhan yang dbang bskur zhes sogs kyi 'jug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha sogs dang*/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyar ba dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥmṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ mgron rnams bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/

de nas/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs yab dang*/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod cing*/ bsdu na/ rab mdzes in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po la/ /byi ru'i 'khri shing mchog gis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /zag med lhan skyes bde la rtag rol ba/ /he ru ka dpal yab yum zhabs la 'dud/ /zhes bstod/ de nas phreng ba bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las phreng ba skad cig gis pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las bgrang 'phreng gi rnam par gyur pa 'am/ yang na gzhung ltar bskyed nas/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las lha'i tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsam la/ yab yum gnyis kyi snying bo nye snying ci 'grub bzla'o/ /rgya gzhung phal cher dang bod kyi cho ga 'ga' zhig las yab yum gyi rtsa sngags bzla bar ma bshad pas de gnyis ma bzlas na chad lhag tu mi 'gyur yang*/ bzlas kyang phun sum tshogs pa las mi rung ba mi snang ngo*/ /mthar he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod de/ nyer bsdu bya ba las slar mchod pa'i tshul mi 'byung ngo*/ /nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de rnams 'od kyi snang bar byas/ dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rang yab yum la thim/ yum rang dang rang stod smad nas rim gyis zhu ste snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar rim gyis thim zhing*/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab yum gyi skur bzhengs ba'i thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/

gtor ma byin brlab dang*/ 'bul tshul rgyas pa ni lha mang nyung gi khyad par ma gtogs lha lnga ma ltar yin la/ bsdu na/ byin rlabs gong ltar ram/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar bo/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar ba'i nang gi shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir g.yon skor dang dbus su oṃ khaṃ aṃ tri hūm̐ las rim pa bzhin du dri chen sha chen byang sems rak+ta dri chu rnams yi ge de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du laṃ maṃ baṃ taṃ las rim pa bzhin du ba lang khyi glang chen rta'i sha rnams yi ge de rnams kyi mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ /rlung g.yos me 'bar ba'i drod kyi rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu nas bdud rtsi dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du blta ba thod par lhung ste zhu bas bcud de dag dngul chu'i mdog can du gyur/ de rnams kyi steng du dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge de rnams yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las ye shes kyi bdud brtsi dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste yi ge gsum la thim zhing*/ de gsum yang zhu nas bdud rtsir thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ pheṃḥ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong sogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod de/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi ljags hūm̐ dkar bo las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar bo nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki ḍ+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tri sh+ya hoḥzhes pa lan gnyis kyis gtso bo yab yum la phul nas/ nang mchod sogs sngar bzhin mchod/ de nas yab kyi rkang ba brgyad kyis bstod pa 'am/ sngar bzhin stong cing*/ srid pa dang mnyam zhes sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba gdab po/ de nas phyogs skyongs sogs skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags zhes sogs sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sogs lan gnyis kyis phul nas/ nang mchod sogs phul te/ bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las zhing*/ mthar yig brgya bzlas nas/ ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol byas la/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs shing*/ ye shes pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥnas shung+nghoḥhaṃ/ de nas srid pa gsum 'bar sogs dang*/ lha mo mtshan ma sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyis smon lam dang*/ shis brjod kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas dad pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni/ lam 'di la dad pa thob pa'i gnas brtan grags pa dpal 'byor te/ dge bas tshe rabs kun tu dpal he ru ka yab yum gyis 'bral ba med par rjes su bzung ste rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig/mad+galaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 98-- PAGE 97-- PAGE 85-
